mapper.sql: s.userId AS userId, u.userName AS userName, u.userAvatar AS userAvatar, s.totalGames AS totalGames, s.winGames AS winGames, s.loseGames AS loseGames, s.totalScore AS totalScore, s.winRate AS winRate, s.extraStats AS extraStats
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_stats ( userId, gameType, totalGames, winGames, loseGames, drawGames, totalScore, winRate, extraStats, lastPlayTime, createTime, updateTime, isDelete ) VALUES ( #{stats.userId}, #{stats.gameType}, #{stats.totalGames}, #{stats.winGames}, #{stats.loseGames}, #{stats.drawGames}, #{stats.totalScore}, #{stats.winRate}, CAST(#{stats.extraStats} AS JSON), NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE totalGames = totalGames + VALUES(totalGames), winGames = winGames + VALUES(winGames), loseGames = loseGames + VALUES(loseGames), drawGames = drawGames + VALUES(drawGames), totalScore = totalScore + VALUES(totalScore), winRate = VALUES(winRate), extraStats = JSON_MERGE_PATCH( IFNULL(extraStats, JSON_OBJECT()), CAST(VALUES(extraStats) AS JSON) ), lastPlayTime = NOW(), updateTime = NOW()

INSERT INTO game_stats_record ( userId, gameType, roomId, isWin, scoreDelta, role, createTime ) VALUES ( #{context.userId}, #{context.gameType.code}, #{context.roomId}, CASE WHEN #{context.isWin} IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN #{context.isWin} = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{context.scoreDelta}, #{context.role}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM game_stats s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.userId = u.id AND u.isDelete = 0 WHERE s.gameType = #{gameType} AND s.isDelete = 0 AND s.totalGames >= #{minGames}
ORDER BY s.winRate DESC, s.totalGames DESC
ORDER BY s.winGames DESC, s.totalGames DESC
ORDER BY s.totalGames DESC, s.winRate DESC
ORDER BY s.totalScore DESC, s.totalGames DESC
ORDER BY s.winRate DESC, s.totalGames DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.userId AS userId, s.gameType AS gameType, s.totalGames AS totalGames, s.winGames AS winGames, s.loseGames AS loseGames, s.drawGames AS drawGames, s.totalScore AS totalScore, s.winRate AS winRate, s.lastPlayTime AS lastPlayTime, s.extraStats AS extraStats FROM game_stats s WHERE s.userId = #{userId} AND s.gameType = #{gameType} AND s.isDelete = 0
